taxonomy.equivalent: Same repository state + environment contract + toolchain + configuration → evidence accepted as directly comparable
taxonomy.reproducibly_different: Environment valid but measurement has explicitly quantified accepted variance (e.g. execution time ±10%%)
taxonomy.incompatible: Material identity mismatch that invalidates evidence comparison (SHA, tool version, config hash, dependency lock)

dimensions.name: toolchain versions (pytest, coverage, mutmut, ruff, black, mypy, hypothesis)

ci_path_note: Live GitHub Actions execution is an environmental limitation; workflows are validated by static parsing only in this session
